description: 50 plain-language taxpayer descriptions with the EXPECTED parser behaviour, written by hand before running the parser. 'complete' cases list the profile fields that must be extracted exactly (any field not listed must be 0/False/default). 'clarify' cases list fields the parser MUST ask about (it may ask more) and must NOT produce a profile. NOTE: these cases were also used while developing the rule-based parser, so parser results on them are in-sample.
